info.name: ShieldOps: DevSecOps Automation Platform
info.description: API collection for ShieldOps. Run 'Auth > Login' first (uses the local-only demo admin from `python -m app.seed`). Requests inherit Bearer auth from the collection.

request.description: First registered user becomes admin. 409 if email exists, 403 if registration disabled.
Stores accessToken for all other requests. 401 invalid credentials, 429 throttled.
422 on invalid repo URL / branch / image ref; 409 if slug or repo already registered.
Placeholder value. Token is verified against the repo, encrypted at rest and never returned.
Target must be one of the project's registered images (422 otherwise).
Requires GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the server and the same value in the webhookSecret variable. 401 on bad signature, 503 if not configured.
